cases.source: Good morning, doctor.
cases.reference: Habari ya asubuhi, daktari.
cases.output: Salaamu anaka, doktor.

cases.source: How are you feeling today?
cases.reference: Unajisikia vipi leo?
cases.output: Kaka kama na kiasi ya matokeo?

cases.source: The bill is 15,000 shillings for three days.
cases.reference: Bili ni shilingi 15,000 kwa siku tatu.
cases.output: Mkaka ya mali kati ya 15,000 shillinga kwa kiasi na 3 dani.

cases.source: Your appointment is on 12 March 2026.
cases.reference: Miadi yako ni tarehe 12 Machi 2026.
cases.output: Sisi kaka ya apokusi na 12 martsi 2026.

cases.source: Please call Nurse Amina to room four.
cases.reference: Tafadhali mwite muuguzi Amina kwenye chumba cha nne.
cases.output: Siku kifungu Njia na matokeo 4.

cases.source: I have been taking this medicine for five days but the pain has not stopped.
cases.reference: Nimekuwa nikichukua dawa hii kwa siku tano lakini maumivu hayajaisha.
cases.output: Aku kisasa mazuri ya medikinzi na 5 daga, lakini mbalimbali ni kama kama.

cases.source: My chest feels heavy and I am short of breath.
cases.reference: Nahisi kifua changu kimezito na ninapumua kwa shida.
cases.output: Mwaka mimi kila na kifaa ya kisasa na kifaa ya kamaa.

cases.source: Take one tablet of paracetamol 500 mg twice a day after meals.
cases.reference: Chukua kidonge kimoja cha paracetamol 500 mg mara mbili kwa siku baada ya mlo.
cases.output: Kaka na kila tablè ya paracetamol 500 mg mbili kama kiasi kati kamilia.

cases.source: I would like to book a double room for two nights with breakfast included.
cases.reference: Ningependa kupanga chumba cha watu wawili kwa siku mbili pamoja na kiamshakinywa.
cases.output: Mikoko kwa matokeo ya 2 nadii na kila kiasi kati ya kiasi kati ya kiasi.

cases.source: The meeting is on Monday, please send me the report before then.
cases.reference: Mkutano ni Jumatatu, tafadhali nitumie ripoti kabla ya hapo.
cases.output: Mkaka ya matokeo kwa mbili 1, sana kuwafanisha mkono yako kama kiasi.

cases.source: Do you understand what I am saying?
cases.reference: Unaelewa ninachosema?
cases.output: Maka mungumu kwa mwanamko ya mbalimbali?

cases.source: I am not allowed to eat food with salt.
cases.reference: Siruhusiwi kula chakula chenye chumvi.
cases.output: Mikoko kwa matokeo kati ya matokeo kila kiasi.

cases.source: Open your mouth and breathe in deeply.
cases.reference: Fungua mdomo wako na kuvuta pumzi kwa kina.
cases.output: Bakamka na kaka wa mwanafani ya kila kifaa na kamaa.

cases.source: The doctor will see you after the nurse checks your blood pressure.
cases.reference: Daktari atakuone baada ya muuguzi kupima shinikizo lako la damu.
cases.output: Njia kila mwanataka kisha na nchi ya mbali wana mwalimu kiasi mbalimbali yangu.

cases.source: Habari ya jioni, daktari.
cases.reference: Good evening, doctor.
cases.output: Message from doctor.

cases.source: Mtoto ana homa na kikohozi kuanzia jana.
cases.reference: The child has had a fever and a cough since yesterday.
cases.output: A child is born with a heart defect.

cases.source: Nimepoteza kadi yangu ya bima, namba yake ni 2233.
cases.reference: I have lost my insurance card; its number is 2233.
cases.output: This patient's medical record number is 2233.

cases.source: Nilianza kuhisi maumivu tarehe 9 Oktoba.
cases.reference: I started feeling the pain on 9 October.
cases.output: Not prescribed for use in adults over 18 years of age.

cases.source: Mama Fatuma anahitaji dawa yake muda wowote.
cases.reference: Fatuma's mother needs her medicine at any time.
cases.output: Mother Fatuma is giving her young child medicine.

cases.source: Nimekuwa nikichukua dawa hii kwa wiki moja lakini bado nahisi maumivu ya kichwa.
cases.reference: I have been taking this medicine for one week, but I still have a headache.
cases.output: Although this medicine was prescribed by a doctor, but he did not take it.

cases.source: Koo linauma na kichwa kinauma sana.
cases.reference: My throat hurts and my head hurts badly.
cases.output: He will be admitted to the hospital for treatment.

cases.source: Dozi ni kapsuli moja ya amoksilini 250 mg mara tatu kwa siku.
cases.reference: The dose is one capsule of amoxicillin 250 mg three times a day.
cases.output: This is a 250-mg antibiotic capsule taken once daily.

cases.source: Niwekee chumba chenye mwonekano wa bahari, na bei gani kwa siku?
cases.reference: Please give me a room with an ocean view, and what is the price per day?
cases.output: When will you be able to go out in the sea?

cases.source: Mkutano wa Jumatatu umehairishwa hadi Ijumaa.
cases.reference: Monday's meeting has been postponed to Friday.
cases.output: The patient was admitted to the hospital.

cases.source: Unaelewa ninachosema?
cases.reference: Do you understand what I am saying?
cases.output: What is the purpose of this examination?

cases.source: Sitakuja kwa mkutano kwa sababu ni mgonjwa.
cases.reference: I will not come to the meeting because I am sick.
cases.output: This is a mistake caused by something.

cases.source: Pima shinikizo la damu na halijoto ya mwili.
cases.reference: Measure the blood pressure and the body temperature.
cases.output: Blood pressure readings for a patient and their blood sugar levels.
